story: Born May 29, 1970, in Manhattan, Anthony Edward Stark was the brilliant son of industrialist Howard Stark and Maria Stark, inheriting Stark Industries at age twenty-one.

Ambushed in Afghanistan by the Ten Rings, Stark suffered shrapnel near his heart, constructed the miniature Arc Reactor with Ho Yinsen, forged the Mark I armor, and announced his superhero identity to the world.
Stark co-founded the Avengers, fought Loki and Ultron, catalyzed the Sokovia Accords, guided Peter Parker, and ultimately sacrificed his life utilizing the six Infinity Stones to vanquish Thanos.

Selected for Project Rebirth by Dr. Abraham Erskine, Steve was transformed by the Super-Soldier Serum into Captain America, leading the Howling Commandos against Red Skull before crashing into Arctic ice.
Awakened seventy years later, Rogers led the Avengers through New York and Sokovia, dismantled Hydra within S.H.I.E.L.D., wielded Mjolnir against Thanos, and chose a quiet lifetime with Peggy Carter.
